thread:
Tara (PM): Quick check-in — dropped a PRD draft for the telemetry UI flows and launch criteria: https://redwood/doc/telemetry-ui-prd-draft 
Tara (PM): Goal: decide minimum scope for beta (PLG users) vs enterprise (Dedicated/Private) before next sprint. Need acceptance criteria and known edge cases. :eyes:
Devin (Eng): skimmed. main constraint: we can't keep full-trace retention per-tenant for beta, infra cost explodes. propose retention tiers: 7d (beta), 30d (enterprise).
Samira (Design): UX ask: beta should show a single unified trace timeline w/ lightweight filters. Enterprise gets advanced filters + export. I'll attach wireframes later.
Tara (PM): Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Beta: timeline + 3 filters (route, model, error) visible, perf < 200ms for panel load on 95th perc.
- Enterprise: advanced filters + export & per-route SLA tags, retention configurable to 30d.
Devin (Eng): 200ms for panel load seems tight if we hit dozens of traces in one query. need caching and rollup endpoints. Can we relax to 350ms or require async load for heavy queries?
Samira (Design): prefer progressive reveal: show summary instantly, then fetch heavy items. Keeps perceived latency low.
Kai (SRE): retention tiers OK. Important edge-case: when a customer toggles retention down, we must ensure immediate purge doesn't block the control plane. Suggest async purge job and a purge-state flag in UI. Also tracing ingest spike could backpressure inference nodes — we should throttle telemetry ingestion per-tenant.
Tara (PM): Good call. Update AC: Beta panel perceived load < 250ms (summary + counts), full details may load async. Add purge-state visual and throttle doc.
Devin (Eng): Implementation notes:
- backend: /api/telemetry/summary (fast, cached, TTL 30s)
- /api/telemetry/details (paginated)
- config example for retention: ```json
{ "retention_days": 7, "purge_async": true }
```
Devin (Eng): Also we need a rollout plan: beta on hosted API only. Enterprise behind feature flag for Dedicated/Private.
Tara (PM): Rollout plan + gating:
- Gate 1: perf tests pass (95th < 350ms for summary)
- Gate 2: purge job validated on staging with 10M records
- Gate 3: docs + SDK changes published
Samira (Design): Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- tenant with >1M traces/day (show warning + cost estimate)
- partial data after retention downsize (clarify expectations)
- export failures (retry/backoff UI copy)
Kai (SRE): On the >1M traces/day case, recommend automated suggestion in UI to enable sampling or KV-prefix caching. Also add soft quota with alerting before hard cutoff.
Tara (PM): Customer asks: AcmeHealth asked for 90d retention. Enterprise discussion: we can support via dedicated long-term storage (cold bucket) but export/query latency will be minutes. Add to PRD: cold-store option + explicit SLA.
Devin (Eng): Dev risk: cold-store adds new infra work (archival pipeline + role-based KMS integration). Mark as stretch for initial enterprise launch.
Tara (PM): Prioritization: MUST for beta: timeline summary + 3 filters + async details + retention tiers 7d/30d + purge-state UI + throttle. SHOULD for enterprise initial: export, 30d retention, per-route SLA tags. STRETCH: cold-store 90d with query-on-demand.
Samira (Design): I'll update mocks to show purge-state and sampling suggestions.
Kai (SRE): I'll prototype a per-tenant throttle and an async purge worker in staging.
Devin (Eng): I'll own endpoints and caching layer. Estimate: 3 devs 3 sprints for MUST + rollout automation.
Tara (PM): Action items: @Samira update mocks by EOD Tue; @Devin post perf budget and infra estimate by Thu; @Kai prototype purge throttle by next Wed. I'll update PRD with these ACs and priority table. :spiral_notepad:
opsbot: deploy-bot posted: deployment started for branch telemetry-ui/prd-draft -> staging (build 4567).
Devin (Eng): noted deploy. will run perf script after build completes.
Tara (PM): Thanks — will reconvene after perf numbers. If anyone has a customer-facing wording for the retention tradeoff, drop here and I'll add to FAQ.
Samira (Design): draft FAQ snippet: "Longer retention is available for enterprise customers; increasing retention may affect query latency and cost — consider sampling or cold-archival options."
Tara (PM): Perfect. Closing thread for now, will post updated PRD link when edits are in. :white_check_mark:
